description: A composite: the rear fuselage comes from 76-8683

One of five B-65s bought by the JASDF for instrument training and operated on loan by the JMSDF as 6728 at Tokushima; returned to the JASDF 5 Mar 1980; the leading zero of the serial denotes 1980 not 1970
Fin of the aircraft that crashed on 5 Jul 2011 killing the pilot; erected as a flight safety memorial
